Name: Türkiye Scholarships
Majors: Business & Economics, Health & Medicine, STEM, Arts & Humanities, Law, Education
Description: overview: Türkiye Scholarships is a highly competitive, government-funded program that provides international students with the opportunity to pursue undergraduate, master's, and PhD degrees at prestigious Turkish universities. The program covers tuition, accommodation, meals, health insurance, and a monthly stipend, making it one of the most comprehensive scholarship programs available to international students worldwide.

Name: Pioneer STEM Tech Fellowship
Description: overview: The Pioneer STEM Tech Fellowship exists to cultivate advanced technical expertise and create structured channels for high-potential engineering candidates. Fellows gain access to restricted funding pools, tailored mentorship sessions with senior staff, and guaranteed admission into annual hardware development workshops. The fellowship provides a full tuition waiver plus a generous annual living stipend for the duration of the degree program.

Name: Global Leaders Academic Foundation
Majors: Business & Economics, Arts & Humanities, Law, Education
Description: overview: The Global Leaders Academic Foundation funds interdisciplinary scholars committed to cross-border collaboration and impact-driven research. Recipients are selected for demonstrated leadership, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to positive global change. The foundation provides full tuition coverage plus a research travel grant of up to USD 5,000 per academic year.

Name: Apex Engineering Merit Grant
Description: overview: The Apex Engineering Merit Grant pairs top engineering students with industry mentors from leading aerospace and mechanical engineering firms. Grant recipients receive financial assistance covering up to 75% of tuition costs and are eligible for a paid co-op placement with one of the foundation's 40+ partner companies upon successful completion of their second year.

Name: Health Futures Scholarship
Description: overview: The Health Futures Scholarship supports the next generation of healthcare professionals by removing financial barriers from their path. Open to students in medicine, nursing, pharmacy, and allied health fields, the scholarship covers full tuition and provides access to a mentorship network of over 300 practicing clinicians across 15 countries.

Name: Arts & Culture Excellence Award
Description: overview: The Arts & Culture Excellence Award recognises outstanding students in the visual arts, literature, music, theatre, and cultural studies. The award provides a non-repayable grant of USD 8,000 per year, renewable for up to four years, along with access to an exclusive alumni network of working artists, curators, and cultural institution leaders.
